about: Rules this project once taught and then measured to be wrong. `tools/argus_ci.py refuted` fails when one is restated as current in tracked text outside the archives. A mention counts as history when its paragraph or comment block also holds one of the entry's markers (or a default marker). Each entry must match its own example, so a pattern that drifts away from the wording it guards fails too.

claims.claim: the lab runs at frametime 0.1, so calibrate per-frame constants to it
claims.correction: every lab match runs at about 70 Hz under +sys_ticrate 0.0139 (pinned since #336); the 0.1 was ftos printing a 0.05 to 0.07 s frame to one decimal
claims.example: the dedicated lab runs at frametime 0.1, id's host_frametime clamp

claims.claim: the headless lab runs at 10 Hz
claims.correction: the unpinned lab ran at about 19 Hz (14 to 15 on some days), and every match has run at about 70 Hz since #336
claims.example: the headless dedicated child is running at roughly ten frames a second

claims.claim: sys_ticrate does nothing to the dedicated tick
claims.correction: sys_ticrate gates the dedicated main loop: host_speeds read 19.3 frames a second by default and 69.4 with +sys_ticrate 0.0139
claims.example: sys_ticrate does nothing to the dedicated tick

claims.claim: dm2 has water to swim in or vault out of
claims.correction: dm2's only liquid is lava: hull-0 probes over every suspect spot read empty, and its graph has no swim links
claims.example: Its real target is dm2's pools

claims.claim: dm6 has a lift or plats
claims.correction: dm6's only brush entities are one shootable func_door_secret and four trigger_teleport volumes

claims.claim: setting colormap colours bot models in the world
claims.correction: GL-lineage renderers key the shirt and pants translation by entity number, so a spawned bot is never coloured that way; bots wear baked skins through the skin field since v3.15
claims.example: setting colormap colours the bot models in the world

claims.claim: rocket splash silently fails against a target backed into a wall
claims.correction: CanDamage returns TRUE on a trace that starts in solid, so splash reaches a wall-adjacent target
claims.example: rocket splash silently fails against a target backed into a wall

claims.claim: W_FireGrenade spawns grenades at the player's feet
claims.correction: self.origin is 24 units above the floor, so a grenade leaves from the player's centre
claims.example: grenades spawn at the player's feet

claims.claim: the combat strafe re-roll causes most bot reversals
claims.correction: the re-roll accounts for 4 of 281 dm4 reversals; the leader is the combat hazard flip on narrow walkways, 23 per cent
claims.example: The prime suspect is the combat strafe re-roll in Argus_Combat

claims.claim: re-fit the played-rate aim spring constants to match the 19 Hz lab
claims.correction: the 19 Hz behaviour was a damping floor hit at every tier, not a tuning; #348 sub-steps the spring at 0.02 s so every rig runs the same bot
claims.example: re-fit the 71 Hz spring constants so their settle times match the lab
